name: Papers by Ouroboros Apps
description: Papers by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Research paper search with real citations from OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, and arXiv: find papers, fetch abstracts, follow citations, and format references. Tools: search_papers, get_paper, find_related_papers, format_citation. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/papers. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/papers.
author: Ouroboros Apps
